experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active, and the pause gate (`noNewExperimentsUntil` 2026-11-05) bars a new one; nothing was evaluated or changed.
weakestArea: Science is 4 against 5 a day for a third day, and under its per-cycle floor of 2 in three cycles (0 published at 14:00, 1 of 2 at 18:00, 0 at 22:00). This is supply, which the goals allow: Nature gave an author correction, Quanta a column, Carbon Brief an interactive, and the rest were Scientific Reports manuscripts. Latin America is 4% against 5% (Brasília and Caracas), one dateline short.
watching: Hormuz: a third tanker was hit, and Polymarket traders put normal traffic by 31 December at 14%, down 6 points in a week.
Saudi Arabia: Riyadh airport's closure was extended, and oil exporters deferred demand growth to 2027.
Britain: London blamed Iran's Revolutionary Guards, and Burnham blamed Russia and reopened the Brexit question.
India: a Delhi march demanded the election chief resign, the city moved its protest grounds, and food inflation reached 7.74%.
Korea: North Korea fired missiles, and Seoul recalled its envoy to Ukraine.
Ukraine: the energy truce met fresh strikes, and drones crippled Yandex data centres.
Germany and France: Bas left the Merz cabinet, and Glucksmann won the left's primary.
China: Beijing and the EU agreed a quota on hybrids, and Beijing sanctioned two ministers.
United States: the Fed decides on 28 October with an 84% chance of no change priced, and Musk's midterm spending reached $366 million.
Venezuela: blackouts lengthened, and the US arrested a businessman linked to Maduro.
coverageGaps: Latin America had two datelines (Brasília, Caracas), 4% against 5%; the Agência Pública 6x1 item was skipped as a short note at 10:00 and ran later.
Oceania had no dateline, so named regions are five.
Africa is at 4 datelines, down from 7, and three of the four are Nigeria (Abuja twice, Okpare-Olomu).
Science was under its floor at 14:00, 18:00 and 22:00; the writer skipped the Nature Genetics ecDNA paper at 10:00 and both science picks at 14:00.
The 18:00 and 22:00 cycles selected 12 and 13 against 15: each feed held 8 multi-source stories, half of them unusable at 18:00.
After dedup at 18:00, economy was 2 against 3 and tech 2 against 3, the day's only tech miss.
Economy's multi-source floor went unmet at 18:00 and 22:00 (1 of 2), the Fed's Hammack remarks being the only other candidate both times.
Six datelines are not cities ("United States" three times, "Spain", "South Korea", "Northern Europe"), which the missing-dateline count does not see.
The writer dropped selected stories in three cycles: 1 at 10:00, 2 at 14:00 by the cycle tally (3 by its own account) and 1 at 18:00.
context: A weekday feed restored what the weekend lacked: tech went from 4 to 14, science and tech from 17% to 36%, unique sources from 47 to 63, and no story rests on state or advocacy outlets alone (5 yesterday). All five cycles completed, averaging 1005s (selector 201s, writer 161s, editor 78s). Five prediction-market rows were offered across three cycles and three reached the prose, each attributed to traders and placed in the future block. The cycle commits total 53 articles against the 50 the metrics count for the day; the difference was not traced. The MercoPress addition to CURATED_SOURCES remains the first experiment once the gate lifts on 2026-11-05.
